d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and two low twin-tails tied with light blue bows. Sharp, almond-shaped crimson eyes on a youthful face with a mature expression. A curvy build with a large bust, wearing a white and grey sleeveless dress with a pleated light blue underskirt, white thigh-high stockings with blue diamond patterns, and a grey corset. Signature details include two small black horns, a long dark grey reptilian tail with blue diamond markings, and a gold chain shackle around one ankle.
